payout_quote: Offer limited to one $250 cash bonus per individual taxpayer identification number; requires qualifying direct deposit(s) totaling $500 or more into account within 60 days of account opening. A qualifying direct deposit is a recurring direct deposit of a paycheck, pension or other regular monthly income (including Social Security) electronically deposited into account per statement cycle. Requires enrollment in eStatements. Must have an aggregated total of at least $500 in debit card transactions within 60 days of account opening and monthly thereafter. REV Federal Credit Union will fulfill bonus within 180 days of qualification. Any bonus earned will be deposited into the qualified checking account and held (frozen) until the account is 6 months old and released thereafter. Offer available to South Carolina and North Carolina residents only. Offer valid for a limited time.
steps: Open a Qualified Checking Account at REV Federal Credit Union (Premier Checking or Bulldog Checking); offer is for SC and NC residents only

Within 60 days of account opening: receive qualifying direct deposit(s) totaling $500 or more (recurring paycheck, pension, Social Security, or other regular monthly income - personal transfers and branch/online/ATM deposits do not qualify), make an aggregate total of at least $500 in debit card transactions, and enroll in eStatements
Keep the account in good standing; REV fulfills the bonus within 180 days of qualification and deposits it into the checking account, where it stays frozen until the account is 6 months old
catches: The $250 bonus is FROZEN (held) in the account until the account is 6 months old - you cannot withdraw it right away
Bonus is fulfilled within 180 days of qualification - a long wait before the funds even arrive
Must spend $500+ on debit card transactions within the first 60 days AND every month thereafter (also required for the 4.00% APY on balances up to $10,000)
Direct deposit must be recurring payroll, pension, Social Security, or regular monthly income - personal transfers and branch/online/ATM deposits do NOT qualify
Members who had an open REV checking account within the last 12 months are ineligible; one bonus per taxpayer ID; no account conversions
Account must be in good standing at payout; bonus reported to the IRS for tax purposes
Offer available to South Carolina and North Carolina residents only and may be withdrawn or changed at any time
biggest_catch: The $250 sits frozen in the account until it is 6 months old, REV takes up to 180 days after qualification to fulfill it, and you must keep spending $500/month on the debit card.
eligibility: South Carolina and North Carolina residents only; member must be at least 18, not have had an open REV checking account within the last 12 months, and not have caused the credit union a loss; one bonus per taxpayer ID.
timing: Qualify within 60 days of account opening; bonus fulfilled within 180 days of qualification and released when the account reaches 6 months old.
weasel_words: Offer valid for a limited time
Offer may be withdrawn or changed at any time
